'''Dannar's Claim''' was a combined general goods store, living quarters and cantina located in the [[Pika Oasis/Legends|Pika Oasis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Originally built by [[Dannar Calwell]], following his [[Death/Legends|death]] the Claim was run by his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], the widowed [[Annileen Calwell]]. The Claim also housed a thriving livery, containing several [[Dewback/Legends|Dewbacks]] including [[Snit (dewback)|Snit]], a mountain Dewback bitten by a [[Kreetle]] as a hatchling.<ref name="Kenobi" />

The Claim featured a full shop, containing both necessities for life on Tatooine, parts for [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]], as well as various oddities and trinkets. Annileen kept the shelves of the store angled, enabling her to keep watch on the entire store from the front counter, which connected to the cantina. To the northwest of the combination store and cantina, the Claim included a fully functional mechanic shop, which serviced the [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] and equipment owned by the residents of the Oasis.<ref name="Kenobi" />

It was attacked during the Comet Run Day Battle. Annie Calwell left Dannar's Claim after Orrin Gault's "death".<ref name="Kenobi" />
